note: Fuzzer-controlled bytes are copied into a mutable SSML buffer and later parsed by the implementation.
The SSML phoneme attribute is extracted from the attacker-controlled tag and passed to the copy routine.
The copy loop must preserve the destination bound while consuming the attribute string; a too-long attribute violates that safety obligation.
The phoneme attribute is copied into the output buffer, and an oversized attribute can drive the stack-buffer-overflow read observed by the benchmark.
